title: Custom detection for remote execution on identity servers (MDI classic alert replacement)
summary: Condensed advanced hunting query for service creation, task scheduling and WMI process creation seen by MDI sensors, shaped for a Defender XDR custom detection rule.
code:
// Defender XDR > Hunting > Advanced hunting (then Create detection rule, frequency 24h or less)
IdentityDirectoryEvents
| where ingestion_time() > ago(1d)
| where ActionType in ("Service creation", "Task scheduling", "WMI execution")
| extend AF = parse_json(AdditionalFields)
| extend ServiceCommand = tostring(AF.ServiceCommand), WmiMethod = tostring(AF.MethodName)
| where ActionType == "Task scheduling"
    or (ActionType == "Service creation" and ServiceCommand !contains @"\Windows\System32\svchost.exe -k")
    or (ActionType == "WMI execution" and WmiMethod has_cs "win32_process" and WmiMethod has_cs "create")
// Allow-list known admin tooling (accounts or source hosts) before you enable the rule
| where AccountSid !in (dynamic(["<allowed-admin-sid>"]))
| project Timestamp, ReportId, ActionType, AccountSid, AccountUpn, DeviceName,
          DestinationDeviceName, TargetDeviceName, ServiceCommand, WmiMethod, AdditionalFields
notes: Without Microsoft's 7-day baseline suppression this is noisier; tune with 30 days of data before enabling, or use the full published query.
Replace the placeholder allow-list with your deployment and monitoring accounts.
Keep Timestamp and ReportId from the same row so alerts get entity scope and timeline enrichment.
